results.title: Multi-standard export compliance across 10 facilities is a heavy manual burden
results.closest_fact_claim: Operations are ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and HACCP process-compliant, following Codex Alimentarius standards and OIE guidelines, with meat exports prepared to Halal requirements.

results.title: Large multi-facility cold storage network without a stated unified visibility layer
results.closest_fact_claim: Frigorifico Allana's frozen meat operations have an annual production capacity of 750,000 MTS and cold storage capacity of 66,000 MTS spread across ten facilities, exporting to over 70 countries.
